Data.description: Output point Shapefile containing the nearest vertex within each polygon (from area.shp) to the reference line (from line.shp). Contains 3 point features, one per input polygon, preserving original polygon attributes (Id) and adding a min_dist field with the computed Euclidean distance to the line.
